title: Output of ATS Jobs & Hiring Signals
description: Normalized job postings (type=job), one hiring-signal summary per company (type=company_summary) and error rows (type=error) in the default dataset, plus a RUN_SUMMARY record in the default key-value store.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Matched job postings from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee boards (dataset view 'jobs').

hiringSignals.title: Hiring signals
hiringSignals.description: One row per company: open jobs, new jobs since last run, jobs posted in the last 7/30 days, top departments and locations, and a 0-100 hiring signal score (dataset view 'signals').

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: JSON with counts of companies, boards found, jobs pushed and errors for this run.
